title: Customer Service
subtitle: Customer-service agents for strangers — they answer only from knowledge bases and service notes; dangerous capabilities are never registered.

trust.readonly: Only three read-only tools: knowledge search / knowledge read / service notes
trust.locked: Terminal / files / computer / browser capabilities are never registered

empty.title: No customer-service agents yet
empty.desc: Create an agent, bind knowledge bases and a service policy, then bind channel bots so it can safely serve visitors.

fields.name: Name
fields.greetingPlaceholder: Opening line when a visitor says hello
fields.personaPlaceholder: Tone and persona, e.g. patient, concise, factual
fields.servicePolicyPlaceholder: Business scope / off-limits topics / compliance phrasing

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? Its bindings, dialogues and private notes will be removed.

chat.placeholder: Type a message — Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.needModel: No chat model configured — pick one in "Model & knowledge" on the detail page first.
chat.agentDisabled: This agent is disabled; enable it to serve visitors.
chat.error: Failed to reply, please try again later.

bindings.domainHint: Customer service uses its own channel bots, fully independent from digital avatar companions' channels.
bindings.noBots: No customer-service channel bots yet — create one here; it will be bound to this agent automatically.
bindings.autoBound: Created and bound to this agent automatically
bindings.hint: Once bound, every inbound message on that bot is served by this agent (strangers need no pairing code).

notes.empty: No notes yet — put FAQs / scripts / business facts here; agents reference them read-only.
notes.contentPlaceholder: Write an FAQ / script / business fact…
notes.sharedHint: Share with every agent (unchecked = this agent only)

workbench.title: Agent Workbench
workbench.subtitle: Take conversations back from the AI. While you hold a dialogue the engine skips its turns; messages you send land in the visitor transcript.
workbench.empty: No active dialogues for this agent. Visitor turns will surface here.
workbench.takeoverHint: Pick the operator UUIDv7 (dev preview uses the local user id).

scripts.title: Quick replies
scripts.empty: No scripts yet — add a note with kind=script and it will appear here.

tickets.title: Linked tickets
tickets.createFromHere: Create a ticket for this dialogue

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.subtitle: Track follow-ups from a chat. Status: pending / in_progress / resolved / cancelled.
tickets.empty: No tickets yet — open the workbench and tap "New ticket" to create one.

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Add background, attempts so far, what you need…

channels.title: Channel Center
channels.subtitle: Connect customer-service channels in one place — configure platform credentials, create bots, and assign them to agents.

empty.noAgents: Create an agent first, then connect a channel bot.
empty.platformDesc: No bots on this channel yet — click “New” in the top-right to configure credentials.

row.deleteConfirm: Deleting this bot disconnects all of its dialogues and visitors. Delete?
row.hint: Once bound, the bot routes all visitor messages to the selected agent (strangers need no pairing code). Rebinding moves the bot from its current agent.
